title: The MCB WordPress plugin through 1.0.0 does not sanitise or escape request header values before storing them and later…
description: The MCB WordPress plugin up to version 1.0.0 fails to sanitize or escape request header values before storing and displaying them in the administrator statistics grid. This vulnerability allows unauthenticated attackers to inject malicious JavaScript, which executes in the browser of an administrator viewing the statistics page.
